episodes.title: Our Twisted Hero
episodes.summary: After causing trouble, Dong-ju is demoted to the Insung Metropolitan Police Agency, where he's treated like dead weight and his fellow world-class medalists also face discrimination and scorn. But when a major case erupts, it reignites the fire in their hearts.

episodes.title: Faster Further Stronger
episodes.summary: At Man-sik's suggestion, a special criminal investigation team is formed with the former world-class medalists. Ready for a fresh start, each member joins with their own hopes and goals, but behind the creation of this special team lurks a hidden agenda.

episodes.title: Million Dollar Baby
episodes.summary: Convinced that Ju-yeong is the hit-and-run driver, Dong-ju scrambles to find evidence. Meanwhile, Jong-hyeon heads to the Prosecutors' Office at Man-sik's request to investigate Gyeong-il's case, and Ju-yeong meets someone in the shadows.

episodes.title: Float Like a Butterfly
episodes.summary: The Special Criminal Investigation Team is now complete with Han-na's return and Jong-hyeon joining. They launch a full-scale investigation into Gyeong-il's death and Min Ju-yeong. As they split into teams and close in on their targets, Han-na receives her father's case files.

episodes.title: Punch-Drunk Love
episodes.summary: While investigating Ju-yeong, the Special Criminal Investigation Team is forced to hand him over to the prosecution after their sudden intervention. Dong-ju is hospitalized for tests following his car accident, and the team digs deeper into Ju-yeong's true identity and his connections to the prosecution.

episodes.title: Counterpunch
episodes.summary: Using Han-na's surprise kiss as an excuse, Dong-ju heads out alone with her on an investigation and discovers Ju-yeong's burner phone. Jong-hyeon finds himself growing uneasy as Dong-ju and Han-na get closer. Meanwhile, Drugmon, under surveillance in an apartment, begins plotting her escape.

episodes.title: Par terre Par terre
episodes.summary: Dong-ju's assault puts the Special Criminal Investigation Team in a major crisis. Man-sik fights to keep the team together, while the others continue investigating Ju-yeong, weighed down by uncertainty. Meanwhile, Ju-yeong leaves the hospital and heads to an unknown destination.

episodes.title: The Aimless Bullet
episodes.summary: The Special Criminal Investigation Team catches wind of Ju-yeong's drug smuggling and infiltrates the customs office disguised as a quarantine unit. Following a lead left by Drugmon, they manage to find the container hiding the drugs but walk straight into a trap set by Ju-yeong.

episodes.title: Allez
episodes.summary: Han-na is kidnapped, and Dong-ju and Jong-hyeon rush to rescue her, only to find themselves trapped in a deadly crisis. Just when it seems there's no way out, an unexpected gunshot rings out. With an unforeseen sacrifice shaking the team, will they survive?

episodes.title: Time-out
episodes.summary: The Special Criminal Investigation Team is disbanded in the end. Dong-ju quietly prepares revenge against Ju-yeong alone, but his reckless move only invites a greater crisis. Catching on to his plan, Ju-yeong launches a counterstrike.

episodes.title: Countdown
episodes.summary: The Special Criminal Investigation Team reunites and uncovers Ju-yeong's huge secret. Growing anxious over the provocative countdown sent by Dong-ju, Ju-yeong makes desperate moves. Who will have the last laugh?

episodes.title: Foul
episodes.summary: Falling into Ju-yeong's trap, Dong-ju suffers a critical injury and faces his greatest crisis yet. Will he push through or fall where he stands?

episodes.title: Load, Start... Don't Stop
episodes.summary: With no way left to retreat, Dong-ju and the team launch their final all-out attack on Ju-yeong. Charging forward without hesitation, they soon face fierce counterattacks and unexpected obstacles. What will be their fate?

episodes.title: Kings Never Die
episodes.summary: Facing their final showdown with Ju-yeong, Dong-ju and the team fight desperately to win. In this fateful battle between two men who refuse to give up, who will be the true champion left standing in the ring?

episodes.title: On the Ropes
episodes.summary: The entire Insung Police Force comes together to launch a full-scale operation against Ju-yeong's cartel. But just as victory draws near, Ju-yeong's most devastating counterattack plunges the city into utter chaos.

episodes.title: We Are The Champions
episodes.summary: Amidst the chaos, Dong-ju and the team begin their final battle to determine Insung City's fate. With the weight of everyone's hopes and expectations on their backs, can they seize final victory and return as true heroes?
